newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bavaria plans no early Viag stake sale - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bavaria plans no early Viag stake sale - paper.

text.p: The state of Bavaria does not plan to sell its 25 percent stake in diversified industrial group Viag AG for the time being, Bavarian prime minister Edmund Stoiber was quoted on Monday as saying.
Stoiber said in an interview with the Die Welt newspaper that Bavaria did not want to sell the stake too soon because it saw it as a way to further structural political goals.
For example, about half the 10,000 jobs Viag plans to create in the telecommunications sector are to be located in Bavaria, Stoiber said.
Viag's chief executive Georg Obermeier said in May he did not see any current plans by Bavaria to sell its stake.
